title: Administrator
description:
Administrator

Shrewsbury
37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
£15.00 per hour
Temporary Maternity Cover 9 months

We are currently recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing business based in Shrewsbury. Due to a period of maternity leave, they are now looking to appoint an Administrator to support their busy Projects and Operations teams. Whilst this is initially a temporary assignment, there is potential for longer-term opportunities within the business for the right person.

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintaining accurate project files, records, correspondence, and documentation
- Preparing project reports, meeting minutes, and business correspondence
- Updating project trackers, registers, and administrative records
- Collating project documentation, records, and handover information
- Coordinating travel, accommodation, and logistics arrangements
- Managing bookings, amendments, and cancellations as required
- Placing authorised orders for materials, equipment, office supplies, and stationery
- Maintaining purchase records, order confirmations, and delivery information
- Following up with suppliers regarding outstanding orders and deliveries
- Liaising with Finance and Procurement teams to resolve purchasing and invoice queries
- Coordinating meetings, appointments, and project-related activities
- Responding to routine enquiries and supporting communication across departments
- Assisting with wider administrative duties as required

The successful candidate will have previous administrative experience and be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and strong communication skills. You will be confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel, and will ideally have experience of arranging travel or accommodation bookings, processing orders, maintaining accurate records, and liaising with suppliers. The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple priorities, and takes pride in providing accurate and efficient administrative support.

The application process:

Our mission is to support our clients in their creation of an equal, diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to providing a barrier-free recruitment process, so if you require any reasonable accessibility adjustments within the application process, then please make it known at the earliest opportunity.

We will carefully consider your details and advise you if we're able to progress with your application within 72 working hours. If you do not hear from us within this time your details won t be retained. So, if you're not successful on this occasion, do continue to respond to future roles we advertise. In the meantime, all good wishes and continued success with your search for employment.

About Us

Prince Personnel are an employment agency working on behalf of our client. Whether you re seeking a new permanent position, temporary assignment or contract you ll find us easy to deal with. Located in thriving Telford, we focus on jobs in Shropshire, Staffordshire and North Wales. Prince Personnel specialise in commercial, accounts and finance and technical recruitment. With the best jobs around we are an independent agency working hard for you.

title: Business Support Officer

description:
Business Support Officer
Rate of Pay: 14.14 per hour PAYE / 18.83 per hour UMB
Location: Shrewsbury Office, SY3. Hybrid basis - onsite days to be confirmed directly with hiring manager.

Opus People Solutions are recruiting on behalf of our Client, Shropshire Council, for 2 Business Support Officers on a temporary basis to support the Children's Services Team.

- Providing comprehensive administrative and business support to Children's Services teams.
- Managing inboxes, diaries and appointments.
- Accurately updating and maintaining electronic records and databases.
- Preparing documents, reports, meeting agendas and minutes.
- Communicate and collaborate effectively with other people who are essential for our service, such as senior managers, stakeholders, partners, and customers, and where required represent the team at meetings
- Ensuring confidential information is handled in accordance with data protection requirements.
- Supporting team projects and service improvement activities as required.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in an administrative or business support role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Desirable

Apply Now!

title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Shrewsbury
Salary: £29,000 Basic Salary OTE £35,000
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 6:00pm (One Early Finish Per Week) Saturdays, 8:00am - 2:00pm on a Rota
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Looking for a role where your customer service skills are recognised, your earning potential is rewarded, and your career can continue to progress?
If you're an experienced Service Advisor looking to join a successful main dealership, this is an excellent opportunity to become part of a professional and supportive aftersales team. Offering a competitive salary, achievable bonus, excellent employee benefits, and genuine opportunities for career progression, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment.

As the first point of contact for customers, you'll play a key role in ensuring every customer receives a first-class experience while helping to maximise workshop efficiency and aftersales performance.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
£29,000 Basic Salary
OTE £35,000
Generous Annual Leave, Increasing with Length of Service
Enhanced Family Leave
Eyecare Vouchers
Smart Health - 24/7 GP & Wellbeing Support
Dental Insurance
Optional Critical Illness Cover
Discounted Gym Memberships
Travel Insurance
Home & Technology Vouchers
Retail & Lifestyle Discounts
Ongoing Training & Career Development

THE ROLE
As a Service Advisor, you'll be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience while ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the service department.
Key responsibilities include:
Booking customer vehicles in for servicing, maintenance, and repairs
Ensuring efficient workshop loading by liaising closely with the workshop team
Keeping customers informed throughout the repair process
Advising customers on additional work required and associated costs
Upselling service plans, maintenance work, and aftersales products where appropriate
Preparing estimates, invoices, and service documentation accurately
Working closely with Technicians to ensure vehicles are completed on time
Delivering exceptional customer service from vehicle check-in through to collection

ABOUT YOU
We're keen to hear from candidates who can demonstrate:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within the automotive industry
Experience using Kerridge, 1 Link, Pinnacle, or a similar Dealer Management System (DMS)
A proven track record of upselling additional work, service plans, and aftersales products
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
A positive, professional, and team-focused attitude
Full UK Manual Driving Licence (subject to licence checks)
Right to work in the UK (sponsorship is not available)

APPLY TODAY
This is an excellent opportunity to join a dealership that values exceptional customer service, invests in its people, and offers genuine opportunities for long-term career progression within a supportive and rewarding working environment.
If you're an experienced Service Advisor looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested in finding out more? Apply today or contact Kieran at Auto Skills for a confidential discussion about this Service Advisor opportunity, quoting job reference 54760.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, friendly and professional person to join our reception team! Marysville Medical Practice has a population list size of 6500, and is based in the Belle Vue area of Shrewsbury, in a modern, spacious building. Receptionists play a vital role in general practice; they are the first line of contact for all patients and members of the public visiting and telephoning the practice so first impressions are very important. You would be joining our supportive and friendly practice, providing a high standard of care to our patient population. Although experience of primary care is beneficial we are also interested in those with transferable skills. Good communication skills and a friendly but professional "can do" attitude is essential. We would be flexible for the right candidate but are looking for someone to join us on a full time basis, permanent contract. For more details and an informal discussion please contact Izzy.Culliss@nhs.net Reception Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance and information from patients and other visitors Ensure all requests for prescriptions are actioned as per practice policy Ensure that all shared areas of the building are kept neat and tidy Management of EMIS Appointment Systems: Book appointments ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and file records Ensure correspondence e.g. Reports, hospital letters, results are properly scanned and then filed accurately and in the correct order Operation of Telephone System: Receive calls, make calls, divert calls and take accurate messages as required. PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. Responsible To: Practice Manager Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Reception Duties Management of EMIS Appointment Systems Management of Medical Records Operation of Telephone System Start and End of Day Procedures Specialist tasks once proficient at the basic level e.g. 1) Preparation of specialist reports including tracking payment and dispatch or reports by Recorded delivery 2) Implementing the Childhood Immunisation recall system. 3) Receiving and dispatching medical records as patients join, leave or die, this includes use of the GP2GP electronic system 4) Carrying out medical audit under GPs direction 5) Assembling and dispatching FP10s and associated Annexes to the Prescriptions Pricing Authority. 7) Recall of patients in chronic Disease management 8) Recording of cytology results and administrative duties within this area 9) Co-ordination of vasectomy clinics and all administrative duties associated with this Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some early mornings/evenings and weekends as and when required

title: Receptionist
description: Receptionist and Administrator Vacancy Full Time Receptionist Working days/hours - Monday to Friday, hours between 8:00 am and 6:30 pm. An exciting opportunity to join our friendly and welcoming Reception team, working across two sites, in our five-doctor GP partnership, based in rural Shropshire, just south of Shrewsbury. Main duties of the job To provide a first point of contact for patients at the reception desk, and on the telephones, and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book and manage appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. JOB DESCRIPTION RECEPTIONIST Responsible To: Practice Manager PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance from patients and other visitors EMIS Appointment System: Ensure accurate and timely entries are made onto the patient administration system, EMIS. Book appointments and recalls ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems or variations required Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and re file records if required, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to Operation of Telephone System: Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take accurate messages as required Ensure that the system is operational at the beginning of each day and switch to night service at the end of each day Start and End of Day Procedures: Open up premises at the start of day, making tea & coffee and make all necessary preparations to receive patients Download Shropdoc reports, print off and pass to duty GP Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some evenings and weekends as and when required
